Cyrus, since my last two emails about your gradebook export got missed, let's do this live. Should only need 5 minutes to confirm the export date, but I've blocked 30 just in case."},{"spec_id":"spec_0693","text":"Title: Garnet Rollout — Stakeholder Review & Go/No-Go
Date/Time: Wednesday, 7:00–8:00pm
Location: Orbitfield Elementary Library (Zoom link for remote folks in the chat)

Description:
Hi all — Thandi here. We're at the point where the Garnet rollout needs a real alignment touchpoint across our stakeholder groups before we lock scope.

Who's invited (12): exec board, room-parent leads, Emeka Ahmadi (treasury), Paloma Abernathy (volunteer ops), Sana Gunawardena (comms), Leon Quintero (fundraising), Zoe Carvalho (teacher liaison), and Abebe Pruitt representing the after-school vendors.

The goal is to pressure-test the value prop with every workstream in the room and surface blockers we can't resolve async. We've had a lot of threads going and frankly the dependencies between budget, volunteer bandwidth, and the teacher-side timeline are getting tangled. Emeka has flagged some budget variance, Paloma has capacity concerns for the fall, and Zoe is hearing mixed signals from staff. These tradeoffs conflict, and we need everyone together to work through them.

By the end of the hour we need a go/no-go decision on the phased launch vs. a full rollout, plus clear owners for next steps. If we can't land it Wednesday, we miss the district's approval window.

Please come having skimmed the one-pager in the shared folder. Bring your workstream's top risk. No slides needed, this is a working session, not a presentation.

Snacks provided. Thanks for leaning in on this one!"},{"spec_id":"spec_0694","text":"Bruno: Y'all, Nimbus 2.0 pour schedule FINAL, quick hour Fri 7am to go over it
